routing_contract.program_flag_formula: OR0x80 only if descriptor+0x34 pointer is nonzero and its first byte is nonzero
routing_contract.sphere_selector: For nonzero models,18initialized parent+0x14C masks are nonnegative.19descriptors have zero streams including model0, but F1533 skips descriptor initialization for model0 and its actual flags are unknown. All natural117..148 are hierarchical.
routing_contract.model_zero_policy: F1533 test model-index; JZ bypasses descriptor initialization at0. Descriptor-derived mask is only provenance, never an initialized model0 object or bank eligibility.
routing_contract.null_pointer_policy: F1533 skips the first-byte dereference for a null collision pointer; prefix is empty and stored firstbyte0 records that branch.
routing_contract.prefix_scope: At most8raw source bytes at the original pointer; not a complete collision program or decoded hierarchy.

canonical_contracts.return: Return0 means the original unsigned scaled radius²>distance² inside branch; return−1 means outside or equality, not a collision-hit verdict.
canonical_contracts.comparison: F1522 signed32 square high words; source modulo32 distance sum; compare radius² and distance² as unsigned DWORDs.
canonical_contracts.small_coordinates: For nonpositive shift, source uses body+0x140 low INNER and parent+0x138 low OUTER, then shifts radius and only relative LOW DWORDs with x86 count masking.
canonical_contracts.large_coordinates: For positive shift, source F1660 shifts the signed64 relative vector and F1333/F1341 sum/shift the two OUTER64 radii.
canonical_contracts.outside_effects: Only the nonzero branch writes flags|2 and unsigned-root-derived altitude; flags|1 compares parent INNER/OUTER low DWORDs only.
canonical_contracts.inside_effects: Return0 still writes output distance² but leaves incoming source globals unchanged.
canonical_contracts.absolute_buffer: The original caller supplies a separate F1664 absolute buffer; arbitrary operand controls do not prove a geometric hit.
canonical_contracts.integer_serialization: Exact little-endian hex carries serialized64-bit machine values; decimal JSON previews must not become lossy float machine inputs.

known_jjffe_variant.canonical_applied_edit: Restore documented ADD parent+138 from uploaded DOS; never silently adopt JJFFE+140.
